This is a 960x540 diagnostic preview, not the requested finished 3840x2160 deliverable.

visual_review.reviewer: Codex direct inspection of the native PNG; root independently accepted final framing
notes: The entire lever handle and base are inside the frame.
Blue painted structure, gold/brass-colored crosshead and collars, steel-colored components and black handle are visually distinct.
Both return springs, mounting holes and central tooling are visible; the rendered assembly is consistent with the reviewed model composition.
Default-scene hard multiple floor shadows and strong reflections remain an aesthetic limitation; a softer studio HDRI setup is a candidate improvement.
Image review establishes visible appearance and framing, not physical material-property accuracy or complete hidden-geometry validation.
